segments.text: Page four, conversation. Listen and read, then say
Hi, Helen. Have you bought any school supplies yet? School is going to start in one week.
No, I haven't bought any yet. I have been busy lately.
What have you done this week?
It's been a tough week for me. I have washed all the laundry and taken care of Hansel, too. He has been sick with the flu.
I'm sorry to hear that. I hope he feels better soon.
Thanks. I hope so, too. It's no fun being sick.
You can say that again. Has he seen a doctor?
Yes, my mom took him to the doctor twice. All he needs is bed rest. Have you bought any school supplies?
Yes, I have. So far, I have bought a pencil case, a set of pencils, a set of erasable pens, some erasers, and some notebooks for each subject.
No, not yet. I forgot about that. I need to get a calculator, too.
I will likely go to the school supply store tomorrow. If you like, I could get you all the remaining supplies you need.
Terrific, thanks. I know I can always count on you. It will save me a trip to the school supplies store.
I'm glad to help. See you in school next week
